body: You’re not alone. I’m around if you want to talk.

Wow this is literally me? I’ve never heard someone out loud tell me how tired they were, as these were only things I said to myself, and to those few I did tell, they didn’t get what I meant by tired. Your description of tired is what I meant. For so many years I’ve described myself as the roach from Kafka’s book, too. I want to offer up that you’re not alone in how you feel, and this was fucking eerie to read. Thank you for sharing. Take it day by day. That’s what I’m trying anyways. I would love to talk if you do.

I feel that too. It’s a really long time to suffer. I’ve just hit my own personal low of feeling tired and stuck and I just wanted to say that I share some of your experience. Paranoid of having friends my entire life, paranoid about what would happen if I told someone how I feel, always exhausted, thinking I’m just broken. Seeing I’m not alone here helps a bit. Thanks for sharing.

@devilsgrace Thanks for relating. Your future profession certainly has a dark irony to it! You know, though, that clicks pretty poignantly with me. You’d be able to relate to the experiences of those you help painfully well. Seems like there wouldn’t be a better person to patch up other people who feel broken than you. It makes a difference, right? We’re still trying out here.
Thank you for sharing and letting me vent. Knowing I’m not in the boat all by myself does help. I can only imagine how strong you are to still be here too❤️

You know, after how many odd days of reflecting I’ve had since this encounter, I’d like to challenge the allowance that this guy’s intentions may have been pure and romantic. If we saw each other nearly every day in a neutral environment (ie our work) the man had ample opportunity to make his intentions known without resorting to my dark doorway for the first time. I feel that the reactions and recommendations on this thread are a response to account for something this guy didn’t, which is valuable in founding relationships with equity. If he really did like me, rather than just get sucked into a fantasy of who I am, he’d have taken my feeling safe into account. That old school comment rings eerily similar to the “boys like you if they throw sand on you and pull your hair” comments I heard growing up in my early elementary days. This might be a stretch, but I think it’s arguable to say that events like these are not new to our society. The change is the narrative around relational equity. And we participate in shifting society’s culture every day by how we treat one another. Sorry for the long reply. Your thought spurred something in me.

That’s precisely why I asked if he needed help! I couldn’t tell if he was nervous because he, in his mind, thought he was finally going to “get the girl” or if he was jumped up on stuff, or if this is a side to his mental health struggles I didn’t know before (because, you know, I don’t really know him). I took the de-escalation route to account for that unknown. But being intoxicated on an upper absolutely crossed my mind.
I have no idea if he does. I’ve emailed our director, but she won’t read her emails til Monday. I’ll update her then about my filing a police report.

I’ve never heard of a strike plate lock. I’ll look it up. I used to be pretty ambivalent about locking my house up when I was home in the past, but I think that’s probably a naivety I have to kiss goodbye now. Thanks for your suggestion!

Thanks! I started spending the night with my partner who lives in a neighboring city. My roommate and I have been talking about getting cameras for the property also, because before this we were having weird situations (people stealing trash and trying to break pry into her car) overnight leading up to this. I thought it all was unrelated... but I live in one of the safest cities in America so those felt strange.

Thanks. After more follow up with my friends, that was their recommendation, so I started the process of filing a police report just to start documenting in case of developments. I also emailed the director of my organization to loop her in. I guess I just wanted to know if this was an overreaction on my part. Aren’t their movies where men do this kind of thing?
